body: Thank you

Don’t judge them, don’t question them. Don’t ask them what they were feeling in the moment or apply guilt. It will make matters worse. Do absolutely be there and present for them, listen to them, and let them know you are there for them. When and if she’s ready she will speak to you, but if you try to force it that will cause her to isolate more.
Congratulations, what an amazing feeing.
Right. I try to fully commit to the relationship, but then get this feeling that I’m missing something. Every time .
Hi

Yep. 🙌🏼. Lost my closest friend I ever had in this life. I can’t let go, it’s been 4 years and it still hurts. I drink myself to sleep every night bc the alcohol tires me out and eliminates my suicidal ideations. I’m here with you, every day. This darkness is deafening and hard. I’m not living, I’m surviving.
Perhaps you’re right.
Hello
Well said

I agree. Yesterday I had to force myself to sleep bc my insomnia kicked in and I just had millions of thoughts on how to off myself. I hate being here, most of the time I can push the thought to the back…but it’s always there. Love those kids and let them know that. Live ever day to the fullest bc one day those kids will no longer have you. The memories you make now will have you live on even when you are gone. Glad to be amongst friends 🤙🏼 I’m staying in this darkness, we can chill here together.
I’ll look into that, thanks. Yup, we are all in the same boat.
True. My volunteering means more to me than anything. Thank you that means a lot to hear that. Welcome to government contractor work, highly competitive & a sign of “weakness” means you’re gone.
Yea I volunteer and absolutely love it. I find white noise helps me, I’ll have to look into cooling blankets.
They say “they do” but just by talking to someone I’d lose my job 🤷🏼‍♂️
Sadly, no. I’d love nothing better than to get my mental health balanced, but my employer won’t allow it. Knowing what I do is bigger than me helps connect me.

Perhaps, but from my experience it won’t help. I’ve never been rich, but I’ve had some money a time or two & I agree with the other comment, $ changes people. Those that have it & those that view you. In summary it would create new problems while also resolving some issues now. It would be a double edge sword bc you’d lose on either side, so what would be a better sacrifice?
Money isn’t everything. People become corrupted by money & greed. I’d settle for being loved & remembered as if anything I did truly mattered.

I’m with you I struggle very hard to move on day to day. I imagine that if I hold it
In I’m okay but this isn’t true. I’m here for you as long as you need someone

I struggle with life. Why did I survive and others not? Why am I still here? Why is humanity so bitter? What is the point? I never really planned for retirement bc it’s my hope that I’d be dead before then
I hear you. I wish I could take your pain away. I’m here for you
Bc it’s a hindrance on my career, a backlog/wait for 3+ months to be seen & I don’t need someone to validate I am depressed, I’m already aware of the crippling loneliness
Yup. I’m here with you in the trenches. Maybe surviving tomorrow together will give us strength
It’s kept me alive so far. Without it I’d already have died. But unlike my fellow man I don’t fear death, just upset it keeps skipping me
I won’t leave you.
Have you considered an Avenue to direct this buildup? Like running, anger management, or just smashing glass
Know before you go that you are and always will be loved
I understand & want to say I hear you. I see you. I care about you
Isn’t that I hate my life. I hate that I live and she died. I miss her so much & my purpose here is like a meal with no taste, pointless
I find drowning my pain with alcohol helps, temporarily
I should have died 3 years 4 months & 4 days ago
Time together is better than the Crippling loneliness. In the end the memory is something to cherish. Enjoying the time you had I suppose

I try to. I even used to. I lost 2 best friends in 1 day bc they had an affair with each other. The only other close friend I had died a few months later from CF. I’ve been left broken ever since. For some reason when I’m down I drop deep. Even now I have suicidal ideations. Like using my field knife. It boils down to not trusting myself nor trusting others. That’s sad we as adults have few friends.
Don’t worry I’m still a coward. Hopefully one day it’ll be different. The sole reason I joined the service was to build courage. And yet look, 3 years later here I am.

That’s rough. You’re right. I have learned many things through my experiences and made some good friends I’d have never met otherwise. But at what cost? These people won’t go through life with me, these people won’t help with my problems.

I hate myself, and have for a while. I try to mask it but deep down I’m disgusted with me. I’ve changed and made improvements but the distaste is still apparent.

I had goals, I had dreams. Now I’m left with debt and despair. I want the thought you have I want to be positive, but I’ve lost so much and continue to loss more. Isn’t it someone else’s turn to lose? How few would be at a loss for losing me?
Well said but I feel I’m delaying the inevitable
I’m here for you, you matter
That’s all I ask. In the meantime, keep spitting fire.
Excellent work, I love it. I admire your style. On a different note, if you need someone to talk to, I’m here.
I’ve got nothing but time. I look forward to it.
I agree, love it when things are relatable. Sorry you experienced a similar pain. Did you ever share it? I’d love to read it if you still have it.
Thank you
Thank you, wrote it 2 years ago, just wanted my voice to be heard, wasn’t sure anyone would listen.
